Robert Williams, who had done nothing outstanding in the longer events, came into his own and ran a fine race to finish 2nd to Bill Curtin. He later started our Youth relay team with another good performance.
Thirty-one members competed in the Ryan Cup for Boys, the winner being Javelin thrower David Wilkinson 3 points clear of Bill Curtin with Bob Williams 3rd.
